prompt: Vert.x CSRFHandler session aware token regeneration condition
answer:
For safe methods, Vert.x regenerates the CSRF token when:

- **There is no session:** a new token is generated on every request.
- **A session exists but has no valid stored token:** a new token is generated and stored in the session.
  - This includes tokens missing from the session.
  - It also includes tokens associated with a previous session ID, since the stored value contains the session ID and session IDs change during session upgrades.

If a valid token is already stored for the current session, it is reused. The handler also evaluates the token timestamp against its configured timeout. ([CSRFHandlerImpl.java](https://github.com/vert-x3/vertx-web/blob/master/vertx-web/src/main/java/io/vertx/ext/web/handler/impl/CSRFHandlerImpl.java))
